Masquerain

Bug Flying

Hoenn · Generation 3

Masquerain is a Bug/Flying-type Eyeball Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 3.6 kg. It evolves from Surskit. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (100), with a base stat total of 454.
